idea-plugin.name: GitLab Flavored Markdown Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Renders GitLab Flavored Markdown in the built-in Markdown preview.

Adds rendering for:

  • collapsible sections - ::: details Title
  • table of contents - [[_TOC_]]
  • footnotes - [^1]
  • multiline blockquotes - >>>
  • inline diffs - {+added+} and {-removed-}
  • colour swatches for #RGB, rgb() and hsl() in inline code
  • emoji shortcodes - :tada:
  • inapplicable task items - [~]
  • links for audio and video
  • permalink anchors on headings
  • references to issues, merge requests, milestones, epics, labels and users, linked against the project's GitLab remote
